integrity: Analytical arguments are in RESULT.md, finite corroboration in verify.py and VERIFICATION.md; no formal or independent certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The global local-optimum guarantee is conditional on existence of exact DR and limited to two seats.
The three-seat construction is an existence witness for a spurious local optimum, not a claim of its uniqueness or of unavoidable failure of a particular implementation.
Finite enumeration supports but does not prove the universal two-seat result.
Priority remains subject to undetected equivalent published results; no independent review has been performed.
title: The sharp two-to-three-seat boundary for local Distinctive Representation
